statement: Build a mobile-friendly, earthy and elegant single-file website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse and filter products, read the size guide, see new arrivals and a lookbook, find the shop, read policies and reviews, and place orders on WhatsApp.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy, elegant look: warm neutral and natural colour palette defined once in CSS variables, with a serif or refined heading font
Mobile first: viewport meta tag present, layout works at 360px and 1280px with no horizontal overflow
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Only facts from the Requester appear; no invented products, prices, or claims
Product and lookbook images are clearly placeholders until real photos are supplied
rules: Never invent a fact; anything missing is marked to be confirmed
Prices are in rupees exactly as given
No sale badges or discounts, since nothing is on sale
Phone and WhatsApp numbers are tap-to-use links
Lookbook outfits use only the 10 listed products
done_when: The site shows the name Thread & Loom and the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005, with a map or directions link
The site shows the WhatsApp order number +91 00000 11111 and the shop phone +91 00000 22222 as tap-to-use links

All 10 products appear with name, category and price: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199; Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999; Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599; Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099
Each product has an order button that opens WhatsApp to +91 00000 11111 with a prefilled message naming that product
Visitors can browse by category: kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts, dupattas (plus an all view)

A size filter works with these sizes: Indigo block-print kurta S to XXL; Mustard handloom kurta S to XL; White chikankari kurta XS to XL; Khadi cotton shirt S to XXL; Linen-blend shirt M to XXL; sarees and dupattas free size
A price filter works across the product list and combines with the category and size filters
A size guide shows chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42
A New Arrivals section shows the White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree and Linen-blend shirt
A lookbook section shows 3 styled outfits built from the listed products, with placeholder images
Store timings show 11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday
The exchange policy states: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, no returns on sale items; delivery info states Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above 2,999, pay on delivery
Three customer reviews appear: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" Priya D.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, no broken in-page links, and nothing marked to be confirmed
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read return, exchange and delivery policy
